title: Human inbox hides degraded reads and would show incidents as approvals that can be decided

delivered: Updated adaptHumanInboxList and mgmt.humanInbox.list in src/lib/bff-v1/management.ts to preserve top-level BFF meta.surfaces and page_info (falling back to data.meta / data.page_info when nested) for both empty and non-empty lists.

Updated useV5Live in src/management/pages/v5/useV5Live.ts with structuralSharing: false so expando properties (meta and page_info) on array results such as HumanInboxList survive TanStack Query cache reads and updates when a cacheKey is used.

Added 'incident' to HumanInboxKind, HUMAN_INBOX_KINDS (12 kinds total), and humanInboxRank (rank 5.5, above 'approval' at 2, with all 12 ranks distinct) in src/lib/v5/management/humanInbox.ts without adding incident to GovernanceDecisionsPage or CONTAINMENT_KINDS.

Updated adaptInboxRecord and allowedActionsCanDecide in src/lib/bff-v1/management.ts so incident rows (both BFF-projected inboxType='incident' with allowedActions={canReview:true,canRemediate:true} and raw owner GET /api/incidents?open_only=true records) keep kind='incident', canDecide=false, and links.manageHref='/management/incidents/:id', while approval decision records (including raw owner proposed rows with target_type and no title/summary/priority/state/status/outcome) and promotion review rows preserve their decision controls.

Updated HumanInboxPage in src/management/pages/oversight/_core.tsx to display the shown and total counts in zh-TW and en-US via mgmt.inbox.shownOfTotalFmt when page_info.total exceeds the number of returned rows, and hide it when equal.

Updated GovernanceDecisionQueue.tsx and EmergencyActionsPanel.tsx to read error and meta.surfaces from useV5Live and display existing degradedEmptyBody / degradedQueueDesc strings instead of their none text when a read fails or any surface is degraded/unavailable, while preserving their none text when all surfaces are ok and no items match.

Added unit and component tests in management.test.ts, useV5Live.test.tsx, revamp-2026-05-20.test.ts, HumanInboxPage.test.tsx, HumanGateDetail.test.tsx, GovernanceDecisionQueue.test.tsx, and EmergencyActionsPanel.test.tsx using the real hosted BFF and owner row shapes.
not_changed: Did not add 'incident' to GovernanceDecisionsPage or CONTAINMENT_KINDS in EmergencyActionsPanel.tsx.
Did not add a second degraded design; reused existing degradedEmptyBody and degradedQueueDesc strings.
